transparency.title: Agent Stream & Transparency
transparency.subtitle: Every game on gamedev.pl is open-source, maintained by coding agents, and safely isolated.
transparency.activity1: Copilot Agent validated PR for Sky Dodge Deluxe — 100% tests passing
transparency.activity2: New spec submission received for Coin Catcher v2
transparency.activity3: Static game bundle published to gamedev.pl catalog
transparency.securityBody: Generated code is untrusted and executes inside an isolated iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts allow-pointer-lock" and no allow-same-origin. Pointer lock only captures the mouse for 3D games after your gesture; the code still gets zero cookie access and zero credential leakage.
transparency.openSourceBody: All games live in our public games repository maintained by autonomous AI coding agents.
